reviewText: Indian Public School provides a remarkable blend of rigorous academics and holistic extracurricular development. The teachers are genuinely dedicated to every child’s growth.
The campus infrastructure, smart classrooms, and sports facilities are outstanding. My daughter loves going to school every single day.

feedback:
Principal sir, Sachin Pathak sir is a man of excellence. He has brightened up the school with vigour which is reflected on the children's prior 
education method and I as a parent feel proud to watch my son grow up into a rational being. We are very glad to be parents of Rajvansh. 
IPS School of Sambalpur has increased his personality . The teachers over here are providing quality education and are very cooperative and 
helpful . As a parent we are very proud to be a part of IPS School. The Principal who has joined the school last year has brought up new energy 
to the school environment and filled the surrounding with enthusiasm.
name: Raj Vansh Agrawal
